identity_check: Confirmed as FactoStack (factostack.com), manufacturing-operations software 'built for Indian factories' sold by Factostack Technologies, whose terms page gives a registered address in Kaveripattinam, Krishnagiri district, Tamil Nadu. A SoftwareSuggest listing for 'Factostack Technologies' describes the same product. A funding search returned only differently named companies (Factory, Factory.app, FactoryFour); none is this one. Category set to 'adjacent' (not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; candidate from a discovery search). FactoStack is a low-cost ERP / MRP for Indian manufacturing MSMEs (quotes, sales orders, inventory, production with BOMs and QR job cards, purchase orders, quality checks, GST invoicing, a Tally handoff), with an 'AI Agents' add-on: a sourcing agent that raises POs at reorder point and chases vendors, auto-reorder, production status ('where is order #X?'), invoice follow-up and quality alerts. Quotes can be sent as PDFs over WhatsApp. That overlaps Utopian Autonomy's procurement and shop-floor status work for the same kind of Indian plant. It is not 'direct' because the agents run inside FactoStack's own system of record as an add-on to an ERP sold against Tally, Zoho and Odoo, rather than as agents plant staff talk to over WhatsApp, and it has no maintenance, process-stability, RFQ or engineering-drawing functions.

company.name: FactoStack
company.description: Low-cost factory ERP for Indian manufacturing MSMEs covering quotes, orders, inventory, production, purchasing, quality and GST invoicing, with AI-agent add-ons.

layer_detail: MSME factory ERP / MRP (system of record) rather than agents on top of other systems: Sales and CRM, quotation management with approval routing and WhatsApp PDF sharing, sales orders, inventory, production and MRP with BOM and routing, QR job cards on shop-floor phones or tablets, procurement and vendor management, incoming and in-process quality checks, GST e-invoicing with Tally handoff, and HRMS. AI Agents add-on: Sourcing (raises POs at reorder point, chases vendors), Auto Reorder, Production Status, Invoice Follow-up and Quality Alert, with human review. Industries: food processing, garments, textiles, automotive parts, general MSME.
product_summary: Factory OS: a single web and mobile system for Indian MSME manufacturers that runs quotations, sales orders, stock, production orders with BOMs and QR job cards, purchase orders, quality checks and GST invoices, with optional AI agents that raise purchase orders, reorder stock, answer order-status questions, chase payments and route quality failures.
pricing: Factory OS ₹2,999/month (14-day free trial); Factory ERP ₹4,999/month (adds accounting); Manufacturing HRMS ₹1,999/month up to 50 employees, then ₹25 per employee; no per-user charges; Go-Live setup quoted separately (factostack.com, retrieved 2026-10-30).
